grain.value: One current Dashboard snapshot: a single captured response object per panel whose metric values are scalar observations, not entity identifiers or row-derived record counts.

population.value: The current authenticated Dashboard workspace: the visible My Tasks category counts, the Service Application and Profile Verification summary cards, the License Distribution panel and the My/Team Performance panel, each with its own population and time basis.

filterScope.value: The Dashboard view is determined by the selected department/role workspace and the applied time range; the observed performance response is the department (scope=1) variant.

caveats.value: Each Dashboard panel has its own population and time basis; values from different panels must not be added together, and a panel that is not observed stays explicitly unavailable rather than being shown as zero.
The License Distribution total is a sum of independent status buckets that may overlap, so it is not a certified count of distinct licenses.
The My Tasks tab counts and priority cards are personal tasks even for a manager, while the Service Application summary follows the backend role scope; their totals are not automatically comparable.
The inspected performance pipeline is application-only, and SLA/approval rates are rendered with the page percentage formatter; a raw/display ambiguity is reported rather than converted.

knowledgeRequirementCoverage.reason: Three field contracts jointly define the key-metric summary as three observed components: overview response (five My Tasks counts plus Service Application and Profile Verification summary values and status breakdowns), performance panel (SLA Compliance, Avg. Processing Time, Overdue Tasks, Approval Rate), and License Distribution (total plus five status buckets). All three cite the same requiredComponents group (overview, performance, distribution) and the same constraints: keep panel names, do not sum across panels, unavailable panels stay unavailable. No opposing clause found; the manual's panel list is compatible and less exhaustive.
requiredPoints: Key metrics cover the visible My Tasks category counts and the Service Application and Profile Verification summary cards with their status breakdowns.
They include the My/Team Performance panel: SLA Compliance, Avg. Processing Time, Overdue Tasks and Approval Rate.
They include License Distribution: its total and the observed status buckets (Active, Expired, Expiring Soon, Canceled, Suspended).
Each panel keeps its own name, population and time basis; values from different panels must not be added together.
Panels that are not observed or available stay explicitly unavailable rather than being shown as zero.
